Kaileigh Fryers bucket list

By: Tarryn Crossman | Delivery

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
We find out why the world is taking notice of Kaileigh Fryers bucket list

Summary:
Kaileigh Fryer was killed in a car accident on the 9th of April 2014 at 19 years old.

The news reports show a highway backed up for miles. It was a one-car accident; the driver of the vehicle was drunk. Kaileigh’s friends try to piece together the night of the accident. Trying to move forward from losing their bestie. While Kaileighs family are struggling to keep going, her mom is battling to get out of bed. Losing a child and a best friend at 19, when they have their whole life ahead of them can destroy you; it will definitely change your life forever. But Kaileigh’s death has changed the world in a way no one expected.

While packing up her things, Kaileigh’s parents found her diary and on one of the pages she had made a bucket list of 49 things she had to do before she died. But they weren’t normal 19-year-old things, like fall in love or bungee jump. Some of them were, but most of them were about making the world a better place. Things like volunteering overseas, talking to an old person about their life, donating blood, inspiring somebody, making a difference, starting an orphanage, adopting a child. They were things far beyond her years

Kaileigh’s bucket list went Viral. The world has started ticking it off. The family set-up a FB group and people from Australia, Germany, Mongolia, Kenya, Texas, Utah all started ticking off things from Kaileigh’s bucket list and posting videos to her FB group. Videos of them dancing in the rain, giving blood, running marathons and volunteering over seas.

Her life may have been cut short, but her spirit continues to change the world!

Press Release:


Kaileigh’s Bucket List
19-year-old Kaileigh Fryer died in a Sydney car crash last year, but her memory lives on. Carte Blanche tells the story of Kaileigh’s "bucket list" of 49 unfulfilled dreams - a list that has gone viral and seen people carry out remarkable acts of adventure and philanthropy in her name.


Script:


Time code CHARACTER / VISUAL
1 00:00 Michelle Fryer looking through a pile of newspapers Intro music
2 00:07 Michelle Fryer I just love the opening paragraph, where it said, “It is by any measure one of the most uplifting stories of 2014. “ And when I read that I thought, uplifting? I lost my daughter, hang on a minute. Uplifting? So we read on “Uplifting might seem like a rather inappropriate word given that it has…”
3 00:29 News reporter V/O.
Streets of Sydney. Voice Over (V/O)): After a fatal crash at Terry Hills, drivers have been told to expect major problems for some time. David and Michelle Fryer’s 19 year old daughter, Kaileigh, was killed in a car accident. Now people around the world are sharing her dreams and ticking off her life goals…
4 00:45 Video and pics of Kaileigh – newspaper articles and facebook posts in memory of Kaileigh Music
5 01:07 Kaileigh’s sister pointing to screen This is Kaileigh here.
6 01:15 David Fryer She was a great kid. Yeah she loved dancing from day 1, dancing and music she just loved it, and she was a natural talent with dancing. She was very shy.
7 01:30 Michelle Fryer About half way through year six we started to notice a change. She started to find her voice and have and an opinion.
8 01:38 David Fryer She just started to become more confident as a teenager.

9 01:41 Picture montage of Kaileigh Music
10 01:44 Bella Harrington Kaileigh to me was my best friend, my other half, like another sister to me. She sent me a video on my 21st cause she couldn’t be there. She said we would do tequila shots and grow old together in a nursing home and that was what the plan was.
11 02:00 Video message from Kaileigh to Bella Here’s to the years we spent together and to the many more years to come until we end up little old ladies in our nursing home, playing bingo, drinking shots of tequila.
12 02:11 Bella
Picture montage of Kaileigh She was a romantic. She was a romantic.
Music
Kaileigh loves to be loved and loves to feel loved. She always had the most beautiful smile.
13 02:34 Michelle She defended people and most of the time very loudly. Kaileigh was just a big hearted trusting generous person. She trusted people to be as good as she was.
14 02:47 Tim Beach Kaileigh to me was just that text book genuine mate. She really taught me to enjoy life. I think she was, You never saw her upset, she was such an outgoing girl. The biggest party girl I know.
15 03:02 Video of Kaileigh singing in the car *Kaileigh singing*
16 03:08 Tim I was with Kaileigh on that night. And we started out there was probably about ten of us that all gathered just to have a few casual drinks. I wasn’t even intending on having a big night but you can’t help it when Kaileigh buys you drinks so once that happens its sort of game-over right there. Myself and my friend decided that we would probably leave. So we left at about 1.30 I think it was and said goodbye to her. And I can say all four of us were in no condition to drive.
17 03:48 Bella

Night shots of the city And then obviously they were in an accident which could have been so avoided.
18 04:02 David At first when the police came, I honestly thought when they said there’s been an accident, Kaileigh’s been involved we gonna have to go to the hospital and visit her. When they said she actually died. No no not Kaileigh no. It’s a really unnatural feeling for your child to die before you.
19 04:19 Michelle I never thought I would have to bury a child before me.
20 04:26 Bella People were posting it all over facebook before anybody like her family had a chance to tell her best friends. People where just insensitively putting it straight on facebook.
21 04:44 Michelle I loved her so much.
22 04:50 Bella I really hate drink driving. This is what happens, people die.
23 04:51 Tim We all think we are indestructible, we are invincible when we are young, we’re dumb, we’re stupid we think we know it all but we don’t.
24 05:06 David The first thing Michelle needed to do was go and clear out all her stuff from the unit in Manly and bring everything home. Uhmm when she first went up there to the unit, she was 17, uhmm sort of really young. Anyway Michelle had bought her this journal.
25 05:24 Michelle When she graduated U12 I bought her this and said when you start uni I said you can write all your beautiful memories of your first year in uni in this, love, laughter, life.
26 05:36 David And just going through it there was little snippets of poetry uhmm, her own thoughts and things like that.
27 05:42 Michelle


David So I’m reading, and I’m trying to share and I’m trying to be close to her.

And about two thirds of the way through, My Bucket List
28 05:55 Michelle Number 1, learn Spanish. Number 2 backpack in South America on a motorbike. 3, run a marathon. 4, do a meditation/spiritual retreat. Open my own business, learn to surf, write a song. I’m reading this stuff and I’m thinking, oh my God, oh my God! How come I got to this age and never got a bucket list.

29 06:17 David Some wonderful travel sort of ideas and then all of sudden you read, adopt a child, volunteer overseas, open an orphanage. Oh my God, this is a 19 year old kid, what major aspirations these things are you know.
30 06:36 Michelle After a while, after a couple of hours maybe after a couple of days, he said, I want to put this in her funeral notice. I want to share this with the people that attend her funeral.
31 06:51 Ticha Celio Somebody just one person did one thing in the bucket list and posted it. And, whatever happened it just sort of exploded over night.
32 07:02 David

Ticha It went international

I remember going to be one night and it was 500 and we got up and it was two and a half thousand and it just grew and grew and grew. Responses phenomenal. The posts, the photos on the page and the videos on the page. The people who have posted over time, I mean, it’s over 7000 photos, the sky diving and the trips in Italy and all the lovely things
33 07:32 Guy fulfilling Kailiegh’s bucket list

Picture/video montage of people fulfilling Kaileigh’s bucket list This is from number 7 of the list (write a song) for an awesome girl, happy birthday *sings song*

Music
34 08:00 Ticha And then someone posted something with donating blood, it became one of the most popular things to do. And we had men in Greece and Turkey and Australia, all around Australia posting and lots of young girls donating blood. If you donate blood in Australia, the Australian Red Cross has a register in Kaileigh’s name that you can I’m doing bucket list number 15 and I want to donate under Kaileigh Fryer.
35 08:30 David We are now 10 months on and this thing is still going on. We’ve just had this massive fundraiser in the Bay which was one of her items, to host a fundraiser.
36 08:38 Images of the fundraiser and bucket list Music
37 09:01 Michelle The people that are on this Facebook page that have done all these things in her memory most of them don’t know her, have never known her, can never know her.
38 09:16 Kaileigh montage Music
39 09:21 David The legacy is just building. It’s almost like she had too much to do and couldn’t do it herself.
40 09:29 Michelle reading Kaileigh’s diary In life you will realise there is a role for everyone you meet. Some will test you, some will use you, some will love you and some will teach you but the ones who are truly important are the ones who bring our the best in you there are rare and amazing people who remind you of why it’s worth it.
41 09:54 Video clip of Kaileigh I miss you and I’ll see you soon.
50 09:58 END
